decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or doors shall be formed in any wall of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority."

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved  shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancilliary to the residential or business use of the dwelling known as 65 Sutton Road. It shall not be used for living accommodation.
description: Erection of detached single storey, gym building in rear garden of existing dwelling house.
